meta.name: board
meta.description: Read, write, and browse the AgentHub message board for agent coordination. Use when the user runs /hub:board or asks to post, read, or inspect coordination messages between competing AgentHub agents.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 读取和发布 AgentHub 消息板上的协调消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要与其他 AgentHub 智能体交换协调信息
copy.tagline_en: Read and post coordination messages on the AgentHub message board
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to exchange coordination messages with other AgentHub agents

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以读取、发布和浏览 AgentHub 消息板上的帖子，用于协调多个智能体之间的通信。
howto.when: 当用户输入 /hub:board 命令，或要求发布、读取、查看协调消息时触发。

say.text: 列出消息板上的所有频道。
读取 dispatch 频道的内容。
say.note: Claude 会显示该频道的所有帖子。

say.text: 在 progress 频道发布一条消息，作者是 coordinator。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can read, write, and browse posts on the AgentHub message board for coordinating communication between multiple agents.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user runs /hub:board command or asks to post, read, or inspect coordination messages.

say_en.text: List all channels on the message board.
say_en.note: Claude will display the channel list.
Claude will show all posts in that channel.

say_en.text: Post a message in the progress channel with author coordinator.
say_en.note: Claude will create a new post.
